## Look up physical facts

Liu Hao, 2026-09-23: "for physical / astronomical scientific things,
don't use memory - always look things up. applies for both overseer and
workers".

- Check every line wavelength, atomic ratio, catalogue definition, survey
  property and published value against a primary source: a paper, NIST or
  another standard database, or survey documentation.
- Cite the source in your replies.

I didn't change anything, because this rule is already in force for both leads and workers. `AGENTS.md:44` says to look up every physical or astronomical fact, check it against a primary source and cite it, and that this "applies to leads and workers" (commit 5ff179e).
